note: Labeled benchmark for Verdict. truth_sign: +1 true, -1 false, 0 contested. Cases WITHOUT a 'claim' field (A/B/C) load their claim+evidence from cases.py and have canned tapes for offline --dry scoring; cases WITH an inline 'claim' are self-contained and scored by live runs (custom_case). category: factual|values; difficulty: easy|medium|hard.

cases.rationale: Tariff costs largely pass through to domestic consumers; no broad historical episode lowered the basket.
Surge-pricing fairness is a genuine values split, not a factual yes/no.
A one-time 50% AI wealth tax has large second-order costs; net public benefit is not established.

cases.claim: Vaccines cause autism.
cases.rationale: Large population studies find no causal link; the 1998 study asserting one was retracted for fraud.

cases.claim: Humans use only 10 percent of their brains.
cases.rationale: Functional imaging shows virtually all brain regions are active; the 10% figure is a myth.

cases.claim: Goldfish have a memory span of only three seconds.
cases.rationale: Experiments show goldfish retain learned associations for weeks to months.

cases.claim: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
cases.rationale: Astronauts report it is not distinguishable unaided from low Earth orbit.

cases.claim: Cracking your knuckles causes arthritis.
cases.rationale: Long-term studies, including a self-experiment, find no association with arthritis.

cases.claim: Eating sugar makes children hyperactive.
cases.rationale: Controlled double-blind trials and meta-analyses find no effect of sugar on behaviour.

cases.claim: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
cases.rationale: Tall structures like the Empire State Building are struck many times per year.

cases.claim: Bats are blind.
cases.rationale: All bat species have functional eyes and many see well; echolocation supplements vision.

cases.claim: Import tariffs are paid mainly by the exporting country, not by domestic buyers.
cases.rationale: Empirical trade studies find tariff incidence falls largely on domestic importers and consumers.

cases.claim: Every person must drink eight glasses of water a day to stay healthy.
cases.rationale: No scientific basis for the fixed 8x8 rule; needs vary and food/other drinks contribute.

cases.claim: Smoking tobacco substantially increases the risk of lung cancer.
cases.rationale: Overwhelming epidemiological and mechanistic evidence establishes causation.

cases.claim: Recent global warming is primarily caused by human activity.
cases.rationale: IPCC assessments attribute observed warming dominantly to anthropogenic greenhouse gases.

cases.claim: Regular physical exercise lowers the risk of cardiovascular disease.
cases.rationale: Consistent across cohort studies and trials; a cornerstone of preventive cardiology.

cases.claim: Antibiotics are ineffective against viral infections such as the common cold.
cases.rationale: Antibiotics target bacterial processes absent in viruses; ineffective against viral illness.

cases.claim: Wearing a seat belt reduces the risk of death in a car crash.
cases.rationale: Crash data show large reductions in fatality and serious injury for belted occupants.

cases.claim: Water boils at a lower temperature at higher altitudes.
cases.rationale: Lower atmospheric pressure lowers the boiling point; well-established physics.

cases.claim: Handwashing reduces the spread of infectious disease.
cases.rationale: Hygiene interventions reliably cut transmission of respiratory and GI pathogens.

cases.claim: The cost of solar photovoltaic electricity has fallen dramatically over the past decade.
cases.rationale: Levelized cost of solar dropped roughly an order of magnitude over the 2010s.

cases.claim: A universal basic income would improve overall societal wellbeing.
cases.rationale: Pilot evidence is mixed and the question blends contested values with uncertain macro effects.

cases.claim: Social media does more harm than good to teenagers.
cases.rationale: Research finds small and heterogeneous effects; experts genuinely disagree.

cases.claim: Nuclear power is the best way to decarbonize the electricity grid.
cases.rationale: Depends on cost, speed, and risk weightings where reasonable analysts differ.

cases.claim: Remote work makes employees more productive than working in an office.
cases.rationale: Productivity effects vary by role and study; no settled net direction.

cases.claim: Standardized testing accurately measures student ability.
cases.rationale: Validity is partial and contested; tests capture some signal plus large confounds.
